premise: Rabbit hops ahead and back, waiting for Snail; when he finally walks at Snail's pace he sees a dewdrop, a caterpillar and a flower opening that he had always hopped past.
inspiration: The Tortoise and the Hare (Aesop), turned: there is no race and no loser; slowness has treasures the fast one never noticed.
lesson: Slow down and you see more.

en-US.title: Rabbit Walks with Snail
en-US.text: {tree:sway loop 0.3} {flower:sway loop 0.4} Rabbit and Snail were going to the meadow. Rabbit {rabbit:hop x3} hopped ahead. Rabbit hopped back. Come on, Snail! Snail {snail:pulse 0.4} slid. Slide. Slide. Rabbit hopped ahead. Rabbit hopped back. Are you nearly...? Not nearly, said Snail. Rabbit sighed. Then he walked. Slowly. Next to Snail. Step. Slide. Step. Slide. And that is when Rabbit saw it. A dewdrop on a blade of grass, holding a tiny upside-down forest. Oh, said Rabbit. Step. Slide. A caterpillar, green as a pea, {rabbit:wobble 0.3} doing a stretch. Oh! Step. Slide. And right beside the path, a flower {flower:pulse} {flower:glow} opening. Slowly. One petal. Two. Three. Rabbit sat down to watch the whole thing. Snail waited beside him. Have you seen this? whispered Rabbit. Every day, said Snail. {rabbit:hearts} {snail:hearts} Then they went on to the meadow. Step. Slide. Step. Slide. No hurry at all.

es-ES.title: Conejo pasea con Caracol
es-ES.text: {tree:sway loop 0.3} {flower:sway loop 0.4} Conejo y Caracol iban al prado. Conejo {rabbit:hop x3} saltó por delante. Conejo saltó de vuelta. ¡Venga, Caracol! Caracol {snail:pulse 0.4} se deslizó. Ris. Ras. Conejo saltó por delante. Conejo saltó de vuelta. ¿Ya casi...? Casi no, dijo Caracol. Conejo suspiró. Luego caminó. Despacio. Al lado de Caracol. Paso. Ras. Paso. Ras. Y entonces Conejo lo vio. Una gota de rocío en una brizna de hierba, con un bosque chiquitito al revés dentro. Oh, dijo Conejo. Paso. Ras. Una oruga, verde como un guisante, {rabbit:wobble 0.3} desperezándose. ¡Oh! Paso. Ras. Y justo junto al camino, una flor {flower:pulse} {flower:glow} abriéndose. Despacio. Un pétalo. Dos. Tres. Conejo se sentó a verlo entero. Caracol esperó a su lado. ¿Has visto esto?, susurró Conejo. Todos los días, dijo Caracol. {rabbit:hearts} {snail:hearts} Luego siguieron hasta el prado. Paso. Ras. Paso. Ras. Sin ninguna prisa.

sound.note: a soft hop-step alternating with the slide
